supersedes: v3 (targeted addition: Sprint 4 measured-instrument-column protocol + the I6 sealed hypothesis; all v1/v2/v3 oracle-column content stands unchanged)
label: Sprint 4 — measured instrument columns (N4) + I6 (localization predicts measured landscape ruggedness)
rationale: Sprint 4 Task 0 confirmed the oracle-only census nets to exactly zero residual (every oracle charge is a total function of the polymorphism profile; the canon-vs-computation comparison over oracle columns is closed). All remaining census science therefore runs through the MEASURED columns — per-language instrument values the theorems do NOT assign — via oracle×measured and measured×measured cross-structure. This prereg locks that protocol and the flagship sealed test I6 BEFORE any measured cell is generated or read.

I6.claim_at_risk: The bounded-width (localization) oracle column carries predictive information about a purely MEASURED property — solution-space ruggedness — that no theorem assigns. If it does, the synthetic world exhibits genuine oracle×measured cross-structure (not just its own dichotomies); if it does not, the localization charge is inert outside its definitional role.
I6.hypothesis: At matched density regimes, bounded-width languages (localization = 'bounded-width') exhibit measurably SMOOTHER solution-space terrain than unbounded-width languages (localization = 'unbounded-width'). Directional: bounded-width => lower measured ruggedness.
I6.predictor: localization (oracle, derived): {bounded-width, unbounded-width} — Barto-Kozik. NOT touched or recomputed in Sprint 4.
I6.response: landscape (MEASURED, Sprint 4.2): the solution-space geometry read from per-Gamma random-CSP ensembles. The measured reading maps to the fixed FOUNDRY_SPEC landscape vocabulary, ordered smooth -> rugged by this pre-registered ordinal (locked here, before measurement): {'clustering-OGP-refuted': 0, 'clustering-physics': 1, 'clustering-proven': 2, 'freezing-measured': 3}. The mapping thresholds (instrument reading -> vocabulary value) are fixed per family in the I5 memo + calibration gate, before any long run.
I6.affine_control: Affine / XOR is the PRE-NAMED exception-and-control: unbounded-width by Barto-Kozik (the sole bounded-width obstruction) yet decision-easy and FPT. Its measured landscape is REPORTED SEPARATELY and is NOT averaged into the I6 bounded-vs-unbounded contrast. Its calibrated prediction is 'rugged-while-decision-easy' (the deceptive-terrain reading); if it comes back smooth, the instrument adaptation is broken (a calibration failure, not an I6 datum).

decision_rule.both_real_set: rows where BOTH localization is real-valued (always, oracle) AND landscape is a MEASURED real value (Gate-6 manifest present). Affine control rows are excluded from this set and reported separately.
decision_rule.floor: n_both_real >= 12 distinct (localization, measured-landscape) rows. If the floor is not met after Sprint 4.2, the verdict is INSUFFICIENT RESOLUTION (a legal outcome, house precedent) — NOT a negative.
decision_rule.statistic: the ruggedness-rank association between localization (binary) and the ordinal measured landscape: direction = sign of (mean ruggedness-rank of unbounded-width rows - mean ruggedness-rank of bounded-width rows); magnitude = Cramer's V of the (localization, landscape) contingency.
decision_rule.test: a permutation p over the both-real rows using the FIXED harness (the corrected _perm_p_on_table lineage: permute the localization labels among the both-real rows only; p = (#perm with V >= V_obs + 1)/(n_perm+1)). A hand-count selftest on a small known table stays in CI (the analogue of selftest_p2_perm reproducing 1/7).

verdict.SUPPORTED: direction is bounded-smoother (Delta > 0) AND permutation p < 0.05 AND the floor is met.
verdict.NOT_SUPPORTED: the floor is met, but either the direction is reversed/null or p >= 0.05.
verdict.INSUFFICIENT_RESOLUTION: the both-real floor (>= 12) is not met — reported at true power, not as a negative.

decision_rule.r25_note: Unlike the oracle-only P2/P3, this association is NOT theorem-forced: landscape is measured, not derived, so a non-zero (localization, landscape) association is genuine oracle×measured cross-structure. R25-netting is not applicable to the measured response (nothing forces it).

I6.owner_review_checkpoint: the I6 verdict is reported RAW to the owner before it enters the Sprint 4 findings doc.
I6.status: pre-registered; UNTESTED until Sprint 4.2 measured cells exist.

measured_column_protocol.provenance: every measured cell (landscape, average_case) carries full {prereg, manifest, seeds, code_commit} and validates through the shared kernel (Gate 6). `measured` is NEVER silently upgraded from `open`; a cell becomes measured only with its manifest.
measured_column_protocol.calibration_gate_before_any_long_run: planted / known-terrain calibration per ensemble family. The canon anchors are the standard: the 3-SAT-family ensembles MUST reproduce the known Proof-Census C2/C3 signatures (backbone direction, province separation) before any novel family's readings are trusted. XOR/affine is the known-terrain DECEPTION control: its measured landscape must return rugged-while-decision-easy, or the instrument adaptation is declared broken and no measured cell is emitted.
measured_column_protocol.glitch_bounds: S1-vs-S1 glitch bounds per family BEFORE any cross-sampler (S1-vs-S2) read; trend-based concordance per the C3 discipline (no single-alpha point reads).
measured_column_protocol.noise_floor_before_findings: the between-seed / between-generation noise floor for each measured family is computed and committed BEFORE any I6 or measured finding is read.
measured_column_protocol.budget: within the standing $50 CPU ceiling; kill-3 wall-clock rule armed — any per-ensemble run exceeding 2x its pre-run estimate before the first checkpoint is CUT and the omission documented (R15, not a silent drop).

i5_ensemble_policy.instrument_side_choice: per family, logged in the I5 memo BEFORE generation: NP-side languages (near/above their satisfiability threshold) support a well-posed UNSAT regime for the proof-side instrument; P-side (polynomial-decision) languages have no hard unsat regime and instead take the SOLUTION-side instruments (the landscape of the solution SET, not refutations).
i5_ensemble_policy.alpha_grid: a per-family density (alpha) grid replaces the 3-SAT-specific ALPHAS, fixed per family in the I5 memo before generation.
i5_ensemble_policy.n_a_discipline: a family with no sensible ensemble (e.g. trivially-satisfiable / constant-valid classes) gets a landscape/average_case cell of `n.a.` with the reason logged (R15) — never a silent drop.

unchanged_from_v3: P1 (NPI calibration), H_P2_scaled (the scaled-census P2 hypothesis — now with its R25 residual confirmed zero at Sprint 4 Task 0), P2 v1 disposition, P3 (census dimensionality / gradient-both-worlds), the 6 registration anchors + projection-not-inclusion, roster/generations policy, and the kill thresholds all stand exactly. v4 ADDS only the Sprint 4 measured-column protocol and the I6 sealed hypothesis; it touches no oracle column.
